one_line: An "open it with me" take: pick from a stack aloud, show contents, end with who to send it to.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a woman leans on four stacked kit boxes, a blue pom-pom at her lips, speaking to the lens. Said and subtitled: "בואו נפתח ביחד ערכה של purples". A cutaway at 0:01.5: paint poured over a figure.
q1_hook.why: A face and a direct invitation from frame one (H4, F6), subtitled at once (H6). The colourful pour cutaway at 0:01.5 promises the result and the stack shows the product (H1, H2). The first words are a task, not a promise or question, so the pull is personality (H5).

beats.what: Leaning on four kit boxes, she invites "בואו נפתח ביחד"; a 2 s pour cutaway
beats.why: An invitation and the result in one

beats.what: She holds up the Hello Kitty, Stitch, duck and bear boxes and picks the bear
beats.why: A live choice makes viewers pick along

beats.what: On the floor, she opens the box: figure, sheet, gloves, paints, cup
beats.why: Shows what comes in the box

beats.what: Pours gold, white, blue into a paper cup; top-down cutaway of a pour
beats.why: The mixing step, said and shown

beats.what: Sheet and figure on the box; she explains pouring; a family cutaway of a pour at 0:55
Holds up the green spoon-spatula: "מעולה לכל הבחינות"
beats.why: A tool tip that is easy to repeat

beats.what: Turns the figure gently, keeps pouring; a boy pours in a cutaway at 1:18
Beside a plain white figure and the box art: "תשימו את זה ליבוש"
beats.why: The finish is only told, not shown
A named person and a reason to send

beats.what: The coupon and where to buy, said and subtitled

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Said and subtitled at 1:30: send it to parents with no idea for a fun afternoon with the kids. The caption asks nothing. The live choice of box at 0:05 invites picking along.
q2_flow.why: She opens a gap at 0:03 ("I will show you the technique along the way") and delivers it at 1:21 (H5). Only four short cutaways break one long talking take (R3). At 108 s the stretch from 0:58 to 1:12 on a spatula and the last 17 s of coupon talk sag (R1, R2).

q3_cta.what: Said and subtitled 1:30: "תשלחו להורים שאין להם איזה רעיון לאיזה אחה"צ כיפי עם הילדים". Then 1:37 to 1:47: "פלפוט יש לי קופון גם באתר עצמו וגם..." and where to find it. No code shown. Caption: no ask.
q3_cta.why: The send ask names a recipient and a reason, after the value (C4, C6). It is followed at once by a second ask, buy with a coupon, with no code visible, so the coupon cannot be used from the video (C1, C6). Both asks sit in the bottom band (T4).

q4_shown.what: Four kit boxes at 0:00 and the bear kit opened on the floor: figure, sheet, gloves, paints, cup, tool. Pouring appears only in cutaways (0:01, 0:40, 0:55, 1:18). The finished look is box art at 1:21. No finished figure of her own, no price, no code.
q4_shown.why: Opening a kit live, first-hand, shows what comes in the box (S6). The payoff, a finished painted figure, is never shown, against R4. Cutaways bring in children (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 11 shots in 108 s (first pass): mostly one floor-sitting take with jump cuts, plus four 2 to 3 s pour cutaways. No speed changes seen. Subtitles in 1 to 2 line phrases follow the speech. Ends on the talking head, no end card.
q5_edit.why: Jump cuts keep the chatty rhythm and remove pauses (E2). Phrase subtitles work muted (E4, T1) but sit over the boxes and her lap (T4). At 108 s it is long for one kit (R2, R1), and the last 17 s add only a coupon and where to buy (E8).

q6_topic.what: An unboxing and how-to of a paint-pour kit, ending with a send-to-a-friend idea and a coupon. It serves parents looking for a creative afternoon activity.
q6_topic.why: A creative afternoon is a real parent need (K6), explained by a person with energy (K4), and "send to parents with no idea" gives a reason to forward it (R5). It has no emotional peak and never shows the finished piece (K1, K2).

q7_filmed.what: A propped phone at eye level, static, her sitting on the floor in a living room, side daylight. She talks to the lens and holds boxes and tools up to the camera. A lavalier-style pom-pom hangs on her top. Four handheld or top-down cutaways.
q7_filmed.why: A propped phone, home setting and direct address look creator-made (H8, E6, F6), and holding items to the lens suits a phone screen (F4). The kit pieces are small in the wide frame, and the lower band is covered by subtitles (F4, F2).

q8_text.on_screen: White bold subtitles, 1 to 2 lines, about 78% down the frame over the boxes and her lap, phrase by phrase: 0:00 "בואו נפתח ביחד", 0:01.5 "ערכה של purples", 0:27 "ואז יש גם כפפות", 1:03 "מעולה לכל הבחינות", 1:30 "תשלחו להורים שאין להם איזה", 1:37 "פלפוט יש לי קופון". No headline card, price or code.
q8_text.caption: "בואו נפתח ביחד ערכה של pour palz" and "וכולל הסברים איך יוצרים!". About 12 words. No hashtags, no CTA, no tag, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: Subtitles make it work muted (T1) but fill the bottom band over the product (T4, F2). The caption repeats the opening line and adds no search words or hashtags (T7). A coupon is pitched with no disclosure (T8, S7). The brand is subtitled "purples"; no principle in the list covers that.

weak_points: 108 s is long for one kit; no finished figure of her own; the brand subtitled "purples"; subtitles in the bottom band; no code shown for the coupon; undisclosed collaboration; children in the cutaways.
lumebook_takeaway: Prop the phone on a table, stack a few LumeBook books, pick one aloud, flip through it, and end with whom to send it to.
not_verified: Music (not established); the coupon amount and code; whether the cutaways reuse footage from the creator's other Reel DdZfnJfsAaV (they look alike); the transcript covers 90 s, so 1:30 to 1:47 is read from subtitles. Correction to src/coded: the pom-pom held to her lips at 0:00 hangs on her top later, so it is probably a microphone cover.
